news.title: Murder suspect dies after fall from Atlanta apartment balcony, GBI says
news.summary: A body was found along Chattahoochee Avenue on Tuesday morning.

news.title: Person found dead near metro Atlanta pond
news.summary: A person was found dead near a pond, Cobb County police reported Tuesday.

news.title: Man re-indicted in Gwinnett death penalty case over killing of officer
news.summary: Gwinnett County Senior Officer Pradeep Tamang, 25, died in a February shooting, and another officer was seriously hurt. Kevin Andrews is charged with murder.

news.title: GBI joins death investigation in northwest Atlanta
news.summary: State agents joined an Atlanta death investigation on Chattahoochee Avenue NW Tuesday following a request from local authorities.

news.title: 1 of 3 men reported missing in metro Atlanta area still missing
news.summary: Authorities asked for the public’s help Monday night in locating three men reported missing in separate metro Atlanta cases.

news.title: Red light crash in Snellville leaves 1 dead, 1 hospitalized
news.summary: A fatal two-vehicle collision shut down a Snellville intersection Monday morning after a pickup truck ran a red light and slammed into a sedan, according to police.

news.title: Ex-East Point officer gets life in prison for sexual assault of teen girl
news.summary: Richard Gooddine was convicted at trial earlier this month on five sex crimes counts.

news.title: Young brothers killed in tragic Stone Mountain shooting identified as police search for suspect
news.summary: Family members shared photos of the two brothers with 11Alive. One showed Jamarion wearing a Daffy Duck shirt. Another showed Jahki holding a school certificate.
